verdicts.rationale: The only candidate flags Navia's charged attack as unmodeled. It fails the purpose test on three independent grounds. (1) Constitution-excluded: the CA is a stamina-drain claymore spin, and stamina is out of scope for the planner. (2) No rendered surface to diverge from: chargeFrames are unavailable, so there is no CA timing shown for Navia to contradict, and the normal ability declares only 'N' as input. (3) Not decision-relevant: this is the generic claymore stamina-drain CA (same pattern as freminet's flagged CA), never used in Navia's rotation, and the note is frame-data-availability/curator process talk rather than a real timeline divergence. Not implementable (frame gap + stamina out of scope). Default noCaveat holds.
